xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5225: pan close still compares MYN repos against stale local main after PAN-5209 (fetch fails inside close-out)

plan.title: pan close still compares MYN repos against stale local main after PAN-5209 (fetch fails inside close-out)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The reported pan close failures for MIN-1140/MIN-1139 ran the pre-PAN-5209 build: ~/.overdeck/cli-bin/pan (first on PATH) still pointed at generation-b (70816bc8790, built before PAN-5209), because pan reload repoints only the npm-global link, never the cli-bin shim. A read-only probe of the PAN-5209 code shows rows 1, 2 and 4 now pass for MIN-1140, but row 5 (post-merge) always misses for non-GitHub-tracked issues (no canonical state, no PR mergedAt), MIN-1139 rows 1/2 call an openclaw-plugin branch with no net changes 'unlanded', and a failed fetch still falls back to stale local main over an existing origin/main.
narratives.Proposal: (1) pan reload rewrites the cli-bin shim to the activated generation. (2) resolveTargetComparison prefers the last-fetched origin/<target> over local <target> after a failed fetch, with a note. (3) Rows 1/2 landing evidence treats an empty three-dot diff as no-branch-work. (4) Extract row 5 into dod-post-merge-row.ts (dod-gate.ts is at 992/1000 lines), then (5) let row 5 pass a non-GitHub issue on the same memoized complete forge-merge verdict rows 1/2 read. (6) Docs + changelog. (7) Record a read-only DoD probe for both issues in the PR; the real close runs after merge and reload.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Must not change row 3 (verification) or add a way to close MIN-1139 without an operator decision on its failed frontend-lint artifact
- Must not run the real pan close for MIN-1139/MIN-1140 from the work agent
- Must not change rows 1/2's refusal to judge after a failed target fetch (comparison.note stays unverifiable)
- Must not fix pipeline-membership-gather resolveRepositoryDefaultBranch or close-out.ts isBranchMerged (still prefer local main)
- Must not extend pan doctor's CLI Generation check to the shim
- Must not read Linear state for the row 5 canonical state
- Must not edit scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt or add circular-deps baseline entries
- Must not mark issue requirement 3 satisfied for MIN-1139 (its row 3 miss needs a fresh green verification run or an operator decision)

autoDecisions.summary: Root cause is the stale cli-bin shim (pre-PAN-5209 generation-b), not a fetch failing inside pan close; no investigation spike
autoDecisions.rationale: generation-b checkout is 70816bc8790 and its dist lacks every PAN-5209 string; the shim was repointed to generation-a 35 s after the issue was filed; the reported texts match the old code exactly; a probe of the new code in an agent shell fetched successfully

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the shim in pan reload activation rather than in pan close
autoDecisions.rationale: every pan verb runs through the shim; reload is the one place that knows a new generation went live, and it already repoints the npm-global link

autoDecisions.summary: MIN-1139 row 3 (failed frontend-lint verification artifact) stays a genuine miss; issue requirement 3 is met for MIN-1140 and for MIN-1139 rows 1, 2, 4 and 5
autoDecisions.rationale: weakening a real failed verification verdict would be a policy change outside this bug; the operator decides between --accept-verification and a fresh verification run

autoDecisions.summary: Row 5 reuses the memoized complete forge-merge verdict instead of branch containment
autoDecisions.rationale: containment compares against stale local main and lists myn-skills/openclaw-plugin as unmerged; a complete forge verdict is the non-GitHub analogue of the PR mergedAt that row 5 already accepts

autoDecisions.summary: Empty three-dot diff (no path exclusions) is the no-branch-work rule for rows 1/2
autoDecisions.rationale: it compares against the merge-base so it survives the target advancing (two-tree equality would not), and a squash-merged branch without an artifact still shows its work

autoDecisions.summary: Live check is a read-only evaluateDodGate probe recorded in the PR; the real pan close runs after merge and pan reload
autoDecisions.rationale: the deployed pan will not carry this fix before merge, and a passing close-out irreversibly removes workspaces and closes tracker issues

Success prints dim `  pan CLI shim → <deployRoot>`; missing-bundle/error prints red and returns `pan CLI shim repoint failed — the shell pan still runs the previous generation (PAN-5225): <reason>`. In src/cli/commands/__tests__/reload.test.ts add a writePanCliShims mock (vi.mock('../../../lib/pan-cli-shim.js')) defaulting to { status: 'written' } in beforeEach — mandatory so no test writes the real ~/.overdeck/cli-bin — and add the tests named in WI-1. After the branch-containment block and before the final return: if !lifecycleObserved && landing?.forgeMerge, await readForgeMergeVerdict(landing.forgeMerge); on kind 'complete' return result('post-merge', blockingAgents.length === 0 ? metadata.sizeJustification: Only two code subsystems change (src/cli/commands reload, src/lib/lifecycle close-out DoD); the other six 'subsystems' are their test directories (src/cli/commands/__tests__, tests/unit/lib/lifecycle), the required docs (docs/, changelog.d/, .overdeck/context/codebase/) and the committed probe evidence (.pan/drafts/). All seven items serve one bug report whose live acceptance check (the MIN-1140 close-out) needs every fix at once: the shim fix makes pan run the new code, and the DoD fixes make that code pass. Splitting into siblings would leave the issue's acceptance check unverifiable until all siblings merged.
